title: Brutal Death
description: Adds a configurable list of spewed items when a player is killed.
body:
A very basic plugin with a huge impact on immersion. Adds items that "spew" out of a killed player. By default: bones, fermented spider eyes and red dyes. Which simulate blood, sliced organs and bones. (These items are only a temporary effect and not able to be picked up by players)

An easy to understand configuration.

![Config.yml](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f82ef939e9e3c1e18e1daf443c6798a871063a57.png)

Adds a cool effect upon a player being killed.

![Player Death Spew](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d575445bb3e2cbfe186ee78c0ee22b08d830fb89.png)
